prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop personal portfolio website mockup for Shun Ren, edge-to-edge landscape viewport, crisp readable interface text, no browser or device frame. This is a personal site that can also serve as a resume: visitors should immediately understand his role and find his real projects. Exact visible text: 'Shun Ren'; 'Singapore-based security & software engineer'; navigation 'Home', 'About me', 'Projects'; project titles 'Space Invaders-like game' and 'Spotify Time Machine'; skills 'Python', 'HTML', 'Nessus Essentials'; contact 'Get In Touch', 'Contact me'. Do not invent experience, employers, credentials, achievements or marketing copy. Composition A: a modest panoramic landscape band beneath a simple name-and-role introduction, followed by the beginning of a spacious project section showing the two actual project titles and ordinary links. Keep typography conventional, approachable sans serif, normal sentence case and comfortable reading size. The visual world is a believable near-future alpine small town inspired by Zakopane in winter: snowy Tatra-like peaks, pine woods, timber-and-stone chalets, amber windows and a few discreet cyan transit lights at blue hour. Deep ink-blue reading surfaces and warm white text; landscape is atmospheric and secondary to the portfolio. Warm, inhabited, optimistic, uncluttered, no gothic architecture, no megacity, no terminal, no dashboard widgets, no technical status badges. Show a real usable restrained website, not a scenic poster. The valley panorama is one composed illustration with ample sky and breathing room.
purpose: Visual proposal only; generated copy and thumbnails are not approved content.
